A.notes: A has a clear "one line lit" idea and carries it consistently through the dark terminal language, hero demo, result card, pricing and install sections. The product is shown working in HTML/CSS and the measured checks are clean; motion appears purposeful but limited from the scroll frames, mostly reveals and state changes rather than a stronger scroll narrative.

B.notes: B is bolder and more typographically distinctive, with a strong yellow-highlight motif and cleaner section contrast between marketing and product surfaces. But the automated checks show a color-contrast violation, which triggers a hard gate failure; motion in the scroll strip again looks mostly like section-to-section reveals, so I can't reward it beyond competent.
